chunks: When you intend to enter Makkah, make an effort to enter it in a state of ghusl (ritual bath), with tranquility and dignity.

key_terms.وَوَقَارٍ: with dignity, gravity, and respectful composure

ai.seo_question: How should one enter Makkah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This text instructs the pilgrim on the proper manner of entering Makkah. It emphasizes both outward ritual purity through ghusl (ritual bath) and inward composure through tranquility and dignity.
